name: unify-workloom-alignment
title: 统一 workloom alignment skill 与需求对齐门禁
description: 以 workloom-alignment 统一 Phase 1.1 的需求探索、UI/TDD 适用性与 design-tree pressure-test，并重构 alignment 凭据、PRD hash 失效机制、门禁、迁移检查及双 runtime 注册。
creator: northwang-lucky

check.summary: 最终三轮独立复审完成，所有 P0/P1/P2 已闭环，Open issues 为 none。最终全量验证：pnpm lint、pnpm -r typecheck、pnpm -r build 通过；core 537/537、adapter-dsh 132/132、adapter-pi 87/87。Pi RPC 实际观察到 5 个目标 skill 且旧两个不存在；DSH 同步后当前 runtime context 已加载新 Alignment norms。行为 eval baseline 受 workloom 全局规则污染，判定为无效对照且不作为通过依据；trigger 描述分类仅作参考。

grilling.summary: Second adversarial source review resolved all late implementation branches: confirm uses synchronous temp-plus-rename atomic replacement; force requires a non-empty reason everywhere and records one override per actually bypassed gate; workflow frontmatter version is the fail-loud runtime protocol handshake while package semver is build-tested; evals live with the new skill and produce a static viewer; changed PRDs re-enter alignment with focused review plus full frontier recomputation; doctor rewrites may add alignment:null to repaired archives; stale executor gating applies only to aligned in-progress tasks, leaving planning research and legacy unaligned in-progress tasks usable. User accepted all recommendations.
